review: Barely functional. This app is an un-optimized mess that somehow takes 400mb of space but freezes anytime you try and do anything.

Full delivery instructions don't seem to make it to the driver. I confirmed with the driver that they can't see all of the details, just the main address. My neighbor that keeps getting them (3 times this week) has impaired mobility, so it's incredibly inconvenient. When I click "Get Help", it brings me to the app download page. When I go to the app menu and click "Recent Orders & Favorites", it asks me to start an order instead. Please coordinate with IT & Doordash to correct this.
online ordering is completely non-functional and the app constantly crashes.
